intent.raw: Look at the card_system_deep_research_2026-05-17 folder and create research to explore these topics and how it relates to promotion governance.
intent.objective: Create a governed research route that extracts card-system authority, lifecycle, naming, orthogonality, gate, and ceremony lessons and maps them to GoldenQuill promotion governance.
intent.operator_sentence: Use the May 17 card-system deep research as a pattern library for promotion governance.

route_menu.context_hint: The route should read the card-system audit as evidence and produce promotion-governance lessons without mutating cards, specs, schemas, gates, or signed artifacts.

items.label: Research synthesis
items.description: Extract lessons and map them to promotion governance.

items.label: Fanout follow-up
items.description: Use role-bound lanes to deepen authority, orthogonality, human confirmation, ceremony, and rule-pack implications.

techniques.purpose: Map card-system authority states to promotion-governance states without collapsing them.
techniques.validation_note: Every mapped concept must name whether it is source-backed fact, candidate, human confirmation, owner approval, active reuse, or retirement.

techniques.purpose: Transfer CIC/CLC orthogonality lessons into grant evidence/KPI/candidate/decision coupling checks.
techniques.validation_note: The output must list at least five promotion drift classes and a guardrail for each.

techniques.purpose: Study LOCKED-but-not-applied card-system drift and recommend promotion companion-readiness states.
techniques.validation_note: The output must distinguish approved text, approved evidence, privacy readiness, owner decision, and active reuse.

technique_overlays.trigger: The card-system audit repeatedly separates signed, locked, loaded, runtime-loadable, gate-live, and companion-applied states.

techniques.validation_note: State axes must remain separate in the synthesis.

technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The synthesis explicitly prevents one status label from implying all authority layers.

technique_overlays.trigger: CIC/CLC coupling failures resemble promotion drift between evidence, KPI, feedback, candidate, dashboard, and owner decision layers.

techniques.validation_note: Every drift class must include a proposed promotion guardrail.

technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The synthesis contains a table mapping drift classes to guardrails.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The source folder contains multiple dense audits with separable concerns: lifecycle, naming, orthogonality, CTO blockers, patch queues, and PRP routing.
subagent_strategy.explanation: A role-bound fanout would reduce overload and let each lane extract one class of promotion-governance lesson before parent synthesis.
context: The card-system audit has concrete P0/P1/P2 findings about authority drift.
Promotion governance needs clear separation between evidence, KPI, candidate, privacy, owner approval, and active reuse.
The immediate request can be satisfied with a local synthesis, while deeper research should use fanout.

roles.purpose: Extract lifecycle, signature, loadability, LOCK, and companion-readiness patterns.
Extract naming and coupling failures and translate them into promotion drift guards.
Use Law-5 funder-confirmation discipline as a model for grant-learning approval.
Extract LOCKED-but-not-applied drift and propose promotion companion-status labels.
Explore whether Program Rule Pack routing informs funder/compliance rules separate from outcome-learning promotion.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the five-lane fanout to deepen the card-system-to-promotion-governance research?

steps.name: Resolve source folder and promotion-governance target boundary

inputs.ref: user request for card-system promotion-governance research

outputs.ref: bounded research scope over card-system audits and promotion governance

stop_conditions: Promotion-governance target artifacts cannot be resolved.

steps.name: Extract card-system lessons by role lane

inputs.ref: bounded research scope over card-system audits and promotion governance

stop_conditions: Any required card-system audit file is missing.
Fanout lanes cannot cite their source artifacts.

steps.name: Map card-system findings to promotion-governance concepts

techniques.validation_note: Mapped concepts must name the authority layer they belong to.
The synthesis must convert card coupling drift into promotion drift classes.
The synthesis must distinguish approved text from companion evidence, privacy, owner decision, and active reuse.

stop_conditions: Synthesis collapses card-system states into one promotion authority label.
Synthesis claims card-system findings directly promote grant knowledge.

steps.name: Validate authority and promotion guardrails
stop_conditions: Research does not name promotion guardrails.

steps.name: Hand off open decisions and follow-up fanout route

outputs.ref: operator decision: adopt card-system lessons into promotion governance or run deeper fanout

stop_conditions: Operator requests synthesis-only with no next route.

gates.condition: Research cites card-system audit files and promotion-governance artifacts rather than inventing new card-system truth.
Card-system findings may inform promotion-governance design but do not directly promote grant knowledge or mutate card artifacts.
The synthesis names at least five promotion drift classes and guardrails.

boundaries.contract: Use card-system findings as research evidence and design precedent only; do not mutate cards, schemas, gates, signed artifacts, or lock-history state.
Model-suggested or metric-suggested learning remains candidate-only until source, privacy, and owner decision checks pass.

authority.lifecycle: Card lifecycle findings are source evidence for research only.
authority.execution: Dispatch route governs research flow; it does not execute card ceremonies.
authority.validation: Local dispatch validation checks route shape and guardrail coverage.
authority.evidence: Card-system audit files and promotion-governance artifacts are the cited evidence.
authority.memory: No memory or card-system artifact is promoted by this research route.
authority.promotion: Owner decision remains the only source of approved reuse.

state_namespaces.write_policy: design recommendations only until operator approval

promotion_splits.rule: Findings can generate recommendations but cannot become approved grant-learning authority.

promotion_guardrails: Do not mutate signed cards, lock-history rows, card schemas, or gate modules.
Do not treat card-system findings as approved reusable grant knowledge.
Keep evidence, KPI, candidate, privacy, owner decision, and active reuse as separate promotion states.
Require human owner approval before approved allowed uses exist.
